evaluation_window_policy: Use the declared available window, retaining all eligible sessions and reporting sample size and uncertainty. No fixed minimum number of future sessions is a completion condition.
evidence_policy: Implementation and report completion are separate from independent performance, statistical confidence and operational readiness. Inconclusive evidence can be reported without blocking completion; existing integrity checks remain required.
historical_evidence_policy: Superseded sealed contracts and recorded status files retain their original bytes. Their former future-session requirement is not an active completion condition.
training_policy: Historical training, warmup and calibration lookbacks are unchanged.
